subtitle: Bible in a Year Checklist
promotionalText: One reading a day, balanced by verse count. Fall behind? Pick up where you left off — no guilt, no account, no ads on the Today screen.
description:
Read the Bible in a year — one quiet reading a day.

Tolle shows one thing: today's reading. Read it in your own Bible, tap Mark as Read, and watch a small square fill in on a map of all 1,189 chapters. No account, no feed, no streak pressure.

■ ONE READING, BIG AND CLEAR
"Genesis 1–3 · About 10 min." That's the whole screen. Daily portions are balanced by verse count, so short days and long days don't swing wildly — a one-year plan is about 11 minutes a day.

■ FALL BEHIND WITHOUT GUILT
Missed a few days? Tolle simply picks up where you left off. When you want to get back on the calendar, choose:
• Spread the Rest — re-divide what's left and still finish on your original date
• Continue From Today — keep the same daily portions and finish a little later

■ PLANS
• Whole Bible in 1 year, 6 months or 90 days
• New Testament in 260, 90 or 30 days
• Psalms & Proverbs in 180, 90 or 60 days
• Bible order or chronological order (Job after Genesis 11, Psalms beside David's life, prophets with their kings, letters within Acts)
• Pick any start date

■ A MAP OF EVERY CHAPTER
See every book and chapter you've read, from Genesis to Revelation. Already read some on your own? Tap a book and check off those chapters — your plan still starts where you chose.

■ QUIET BY DESIGN
• One gentle reminder a day, at the time you choose, with that day's reading — skipped if you've already read
• No ads on the Today screen
• Works offline. Your progress stays on your iPhone; export it to CSV anytime
• Light and dark mode, large text friendly

Tolle doesn't include Bible text — read in the Bible you love, printed or on your phone.

"Tolle, lege" — take up and read.
reviewNotes:
Hello App Review team, thank you for reviewing Tolle: Bible Reading Plan.

1. Screen recording: available on request. To try the core flow in under a minute: open the app (no setup), tap Mark as Read on the Today tab — the reading (Genesis 1–3) is checked off and three squares fill on the chapter map. Open the Map tab to see all books, and the Plan tab to switch to New Testament or Chronological order.
   - The app has no account registration, login, or user-generated content shared with others.

2. Purpose and audience: A simple Bible reading plan tracker for people who want to read the Bible in a year (or 90 days, New Testament, Psalms & Proverbs). It shows today's chapters and lets the user check them off. It does not contain Bible text; users read in their own Bible.

3. How to use: Today tab: today's reading with estimated minutes, Mark as Read, Undo, Read Ahead; if behind, Adjust Schedule offers to spread the remaining chapters or continue from today. Map tab: all 66 books; tap a book to check off chapters read outside the plan (does not change the plan). Plan tab: plan scope, length, Bible or chronological order, start date, an optional daily reminder (local notification, permission asked when turned on), CSV export, privacy policy.

4. External services: Google AdMob banner ads on the Map and Plan screens only (no ads on the Today screen, no interstitial or video ads; content rating limited to G). No backend server, analytics, authentication, or AI services. Progress is stored only on the device; CSV export uses the iOS share sheet.

5. Regional differences: None. The app works the same in all regions where it is available. English only.

6. Regulated industry / third-party content: Not applicable. The app shows only book names and chapter numbers (no Bible text). Chapter and verse counts come from an open-source (MIT) dataset; the chronological order is our own arrangement, described in the app as approximate. All artwork is original.

7. In-App Purchase: None. All features are free, with no subscription or trial.

Thank you!
